description: Searches the whole AnimatedWebs catalog in one tool: animated website, section and background templates, UI library components, cinematic video backgrounds, website style references and verified creators. Returns metadata only, grouped by kind, never prompt text or source code. Use kind to pick one family (templates, components, backgrounds, styles, creators) or leave it as all to get the closest matches from every family in one call; then call get_template, get_component, get_background, get_style_reference or get_creator with an identifier from the results. An empty query browses: it lists the family in catalog order, so you can enumerate everything with kind plus cursor. Matching: for templates and components each query word is a case-insensitive substring test and results rank by how many words matched (ties keep catalog order); for backgrounds, styles and creators the whole query is one substring and results keep catalog order. Filters apply per kind: templates take category (exact, one of list_categories), access (free or pro) and templateKind (website, section, background or component); components take category (see list_categories with scope components) and runtime. With kind all, a family that cannot use a supplied filter is left out of the result; with one kind, an unusable filter is an error. Paging: limit is per family (templates and components: default 10, max 50; backgrounds and styles: default 20, max 50; creators: default 10, max 30; kind all: default 6, max 20). Each group has nextCursor, null on the last page; pass it back as cursor together with the same kind, query and filters to read the next page. A cursor works only with a single kind, so to continue a family from an all result, repeat the call with kind set to that family. Fields per result: templates (slug, title, tagline, kind, category, access, tags, stack, url, demo, preview), components (id, title, category, tags, runtime, variants, url, thumbnail, source), backgrounds (slug, title, tags, size, seconds, preview, poster, template), styles (slug, name, source, theme, displayFont, accent, screenshot, page), creators (handle, display_name, headline, stack, specialties, tier, url). Read-only.

access.description: Templates only. free: prompts any signed-in account can fetch; pro: needs a Pro or Lifetime plan or a Prompt Pack credit.

category.description: Templates and components only. Templates: exact category, case-insensitive, one of the values from list_categories. Components: exact category such as Hero, Three.js or Buttons (list_categories with scope components). An unknown value returns no results.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of a previous result, unchanged, with the same kind, query and filters. Single kind only.

kind.description: Which family to search: templates, components, backgrounds (video loops), styles (website style references), creators, or all (default) for every family at once.

limit.description: Maximum results per family on this page. Defaults and ceilings are in the tool description; a value above a family's ceiling is lowered to it.

query.description: Free text. Empty or omitted browses the family. Templates and components split it on spaces and match each word as a substring ('webgl particles hero'); backgrounds, styles and creators match the whole text as one substring ('nature', 'stripe', 'webgl').

runtime.description: Components only. Exact runtime, case-insensitive, for example react, three or css.

templateKind.description: Templates only. website (full page), section (one page section), background (coded motion backdrop) or component.
